faq_heading: Delta Manor condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Delta Manor sell for?
faq.a: 22 condos sold in Delta Manor between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $535,000.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Delta Manor?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Delta Manor sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 22 condos that sold in Delta Manor went for between $485,000 and $587,500, around a median of $535,000.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Delta Manor sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 22 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Delta Manor?
faq.a: Of the 22 sales, 22 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $442.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Delta Manor?
faq.a: The median year built was 1996 for the 22 condos sold in Delta Manor.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Delta Manor usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Delta Manor had 2 bedrooms, from the 22 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Delta Manor condos and townhomes for sale now
What Delta Manor condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

22 condos sold in Delta Manor with a median price of $535,000 (the middle half sold between $485,000 and $587,500), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $585 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $442 a month. 8 townhomes sold in Delta Manor with a median price of $860,000 (the middle half sold between $833,250 and $895,250), taking a median of 15 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $547 per square foot, a median year built of 1997 and a median strata fee of $461 a month.

blocks.text: How Delta Manor compares with the rest of Ladner
The median condo in Delta Manor sold for $535,000, 11% below the Ladner median of $600,000 across 49 sales. Delta Manor condos took a median 22 days to sell, against 35 days for Ladner as a whole.
